help:
Request:        delete/ocsp/plainkey
Matching Route: ^delete/(?P<path>.*)$

Marks one or more versions as deleted in the KV store.

## PARAMETERS

    path (string)

        Location of the secret.

    versions (slice)

        The versions to be archived. The versioned data will not be deleted, but it will no longer be returned in normal get requests.

## DESCRIPTION

Deletes the data for the provided version and path in the key-value store. The
versioned data will not be fully removed, but marked as deleted and will no
longer be returned in normal get requests. This operation can be undone.

versions.description: The versions to be archived. The versioned data will not be deleted, but it will no longer be returned in normal get requests.
